Class RecordSchema

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.RecordSchema
public final class RecordSchema extends Object
Descriptive fluent API for building Records.

Each method returns a typed interface so that IDE code completion only shows valid next operations. This is the primary API for Java developers who don't know COBOL. The COBOL-named methods (.pic(), .value88()) delegate to these methods internally. 

Record customer = RecordSchema.define("CUSTOMER")
    .field("CUST-ID").alphanumeric(10)
    .field("BALANCE").decimal(7, 2).packedDecimal()
    .field("STATUS").alphanumeric(1)
        .when("ACTIVE").is("A")
        .when("INACTIVE").is("I")
    .field("CREDIT-LIMIT").decimal(7, 2).binary()
    .group("ADDRESS", g -> g
        .field("STREET").alphanumeric(30)
        .field("CITY").alphanumeric(20)
        .field("STATE").alphanumeric(2))
    .build();
